name: Jest of the Scorched Tundra
body:
School: conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: close (95 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: 5-ft.-radius burst

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The burst creates a zone of icy ground until the end of your next turn. Spaces in the zone are considered difficult terrain. You teleport 10 feet to an unoccupied space within sight.
